name: neevcloud
description: NeevCloud agent skills for building on sandboxes. Includes the neev-sdk skill for creating sandboxes, running code, and generating preview URLs from TypeScript or Python, the neev-cli skill for managing sandboxes from the command line, and the neev-sandbox-mcp skill for connecting an agent to a sandbox over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Build on NeevCloud sandboxes with the CLI and SDKs.
